name: has_decomp_quotients
statement: Action FintypeCat G) [TopologicalSpace X.V] [DiscreteTopology X.V] [ContinuousSMul G X.V] : ∃ (ι : Type) (_ : Finite ι) (f : ι → OpenSubgroup (G)), Nonempty ((∐ fun i ↦ G ⧸ₐ (f i).toSubgroup) ≅ X)

name: exists_lift_of_quotient_openSubgroup
statement: OpenSubgroup (Aut F)) : ∃ (X : C), Nonempty ((functorToAction F).obj X ≅ Aut F ⧸ₐ V.toSubgroup)
